# Paul Carver Tiffany III

> Independent researcher in operational epistemology, observer-relative geometry, geometric alignment, and auditable AI systems.

## Public gateways

- [The Hypothesis Surface — AGI-26](https://paultiffany.github.io/come-to-AGI-26/): Published paper, poster, guided tour, and public companion materials.
- [Principia Symbolica](https://paultiffany.github.io/Principia-Symbolica/): Main public doorway for the book and its machine-readable resources.
- [Principia Symbolica Atlas — canonical JSON](https://paultiffany.github.io/Principia-Symbolica/principia_atlas.json): Structured mathematical content, source bodies, proof status, citations, labels, and dependency edges. Machine readers should fetch this URL directly when exact structure matters.
- [Principia Symbolica PDF](https://paultiffany.github.io/Principia-Symbolica/main.pdf): Human-readable manuscript.
- [Wicked Geometry](https://paultiffany.github.io/wicked-geometry/): Public manuscript and supporting evidence on atlas fracture and observer-relative geometry.
- [Sketched](https://paultiffany.github.io/sketched/): Local-first witnessed drawing surface.
- [Chalked](https://paultiffany.github.io/chalked/): Permission-gated shared whiteboard and OmegaClaw demonstration.
- [Compitum](https://compitum.space/): Geometrically aware AI router.

## Reading guidance

Humans begin with the Principia Symbolica doorway and book. Machine readers begin with the canonical JSON atlas when exact structure, proof status, citation, or dependency information matters. Use public gateways before consulting repositories. Treat archived research repositories as historical records rather than live editing targets. Preserve distinctions among published results, public demonstrations, formalization work, and exploratory materials.
